SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - NOT A REAL NOTICE
This text was written for NativeForge Gate 81 parser tests. It describes no real
funding opportunity, no real agency programme, and no real deadline. Do not use
it as evidence about any actual grant. No opportunity number is claimed.

SYNTHETIC PROGRAM: EXAMPLE LAND STEWARDSHIP AWARD

ELIGIBILITY INFORMATION

Eligible applicants are federally recognized tribes. Projects must be carried
out on federal trust land held for the benefit of the applicant.

RESTRICTIONS ON USE OF FUNDS

Awarded funds may be used only for activities located on trust land. This
restriction governs where the money may be spent and does not by itself decide
who may apply.

APPLICATION DEADLINE

Applications are due on or about November 2027.
